description: Reads a saved contract file and describes it without opening a browser or making any network request. Use this to inspect what a contract covers, for example before deciding whether diff_pixels is possible, since that needs screenshots to already exist. Returns the original source URL, when it was extracted, the viewports it covers, the element count per viewport, whether reference screenshots exist, and any warnings recorded at extraction time.

contractPath.description: Path to a contract JSON file previously written by extract_contract.

name: read_contract_summary
title: Read a saved contract summary
